description: Implementation of a FIFO-style memory queue using singly-linked list, including functions for initialization, enqueue, peek, and dequeue operations.

methods.name: memq_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory queue with an initial link-element, setting head and tail pointers to it.

methods.name: memq_deinit
methods.description: De-initializes the queue, invalidating it and returning the old head if the queue was empty.

methods.name: memq_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a memory payload at the tail of the queue, updating the tail pointer.

methods.name: memq_peek
methods.description: Returns the head of the queue without removing it, and optionally retrieves its memory payload.

methods.name: memq_peek_n
methods.description: Returns the nth (zero-indexed) element in the queue without removing it.

methods.name: memq_dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue, updating the head pointer.
